policy: Use 2026 only as a promotion veto after the 2025-only loop has selected a candidate; do not tune candidates against 2026.
reason: The front-row-only target calibration improved 2025 MAE with no XV-value loss, and the sealed 2026 check improved MAE while preserving XV value. The selector is deliberately based on the pre-calibration point signal so a point-scale correction does not perturb XV ranking.

frontrow_scope_split_family.reason: A direct split of the promoted front-row calibration found no 2025 dev improvement. The original 20% combined prop+hooker scope remains better than 15%, 25%, prop-only 20%, or hooker-only 20%, so no sealed 2026 check was warranted.

minutes_alpha_4.reason: Accepted on 2025 dev after a tighter minutes ridge improved MAE and top15, but vetoed by sealed 2026 because both primary metrics worsened versus the promoted front-row model. The top15 and Spearman gains are useful diagnostics, not enough to override worse MAE and XV value.

minutes_alpha_5_to_9.reason: Neighbouring tighter minutes-ridge settings did not beat minutes_alpha_4 on 2025 dev. Alpha 9 briefly looked attractive on XV value, but missed the MAE gate and only improved value in 2 of 5 rounds.

target_frontrow20_back5_20.reason: Accepted on 2025 dev after stacking a 20% back-five prior on top of the promoted front-row calibration, but vetoed by sealed 2026 because MAE worsened sharply versus the promoted model. XV selection metrics were unchanged because the selector stayed on the pre-calibration point signal.

target_frontrow20_back5_10.reason: Accepted when tested first, but superseded on 2025 dev by the stronger 20% stacked back-five prior; the family representative was sealed and vetoed.

target_frontrow20_nonfront_family.reason: Adding a broad non-frontrow prior on top of the promoted front-row calibration was worse than the back-five-specific version and below the acceptance threshold.

target_frontrow_10_selector_raw.reason: Accepted when tested first, but superseded by the stronger 20% front-row candidate when compared directly to the promoted incumbent.

target_frontrow_30_selector_raw.reason: Did not improve enough after the 10% step and was worse than the 20% front-row candidate on 2025 MAE.

target_tight5_20.reason: Adding second-row smoothing reduced the MAE gain relative to front-row-only calibration.

target_posmean_10_plus_selector_tilt_025.reason: Earlier broad position-mean smoothing improved 2025 MAE, but regressed sealed 2026 MAE/value_xv versus the selector-only incumbent.

minutes_alpha_3_plus_selector_tilt_025.reason: Earlier tighter minutes ridge improved 2025 MAE and value_xv, but regressed sealed 2026 MAE/value_xv.
